paragraphs: Idealove® - Treat yourself to an at-home spa day with our variety pack, includes 7 Superfood Skin Savior sheet masks to choose from. Infused with vitamin-rich and extract goodness, these superfood sheet masks can help you achieve the ultimate healthy-looking glow and skin loving appearance. Made with silky-smooth pulp fabric, the mask helps to maximize essence absorption for a super(food) radiant complexion!
Superfood Skin Savior, Pretty as a Peach

This Superfood Skin Savior mask is infused with peach extract that contains a wealth of antioxidants. These antioxidants can help reduce the appearance of dark spots and signs of aging for revitalized and brighter-looking skin.
Superfood Skin Savior, Let's Avo Good Time
This Superfood Skin Savior mask is infused with avocado extract, which contains key antioxidants and nutrients that moisturize and soothe to help skin stay elastic and vibrant.
Superfood Skin Savior, For Love and Honey

This Superfood Skin Savior mask is infused with honey extract that is packed with antioxidants and is known for its antibacterial abilities. It can help to improve the health of skin for a luminous looking appearance.
Superfood Skin Savior, Acai You Checking Me Out

This Superfood Skin Savior mask is infused with acai berries, which are a brilliant anti-aging agent due to the high content of powerful antioxidants. These antioxidants can help improve skin health for a bright, plump, and smooth appearance.
Superfood Skin Savior, You Make Me Coconuts

This Superfood Skin Savior mask is infused with coconut extract that is derived from the meat of the coconut and valued for its hydrating properties. It’s a highly absorbable and nourishing extract that helps restore moisture for soft, supple, and youthful-looking skin.
Superfood Skin Savior, Lime All Yours

This Superfood Skin Savior mask is infused with lime extract and brings a zesty, uplifting touch to your skincare ritual. Enjoy the fresh scent and soothing texture as part of your glow-getting routine.
Superfood Skin Savior, Almond Love with You
This Superfood Skin Savior mask is infused with sweet almond, which is rich in vitamins and minerals and can support a balanced and resilient barrier for soft and nourished skin.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
Store in a cool, dry place.
